description: Analyzes your chat logs to find grammar you keep avoiding — and shows you the exact moments you needed it.
notes: Seeded demo logs; real use needs chat import with user consent.
Built against the shared Kit contract (window.Kit); a minimal inline shim is retained as fallback if shared/kit.js is ever absent.

notes.note: Surfacing the five moments you dodged the past perfect is a cute mechanic. But it's a language-learning app, and language-learning monetization outside Duolingo's freemium is a graveyard; $6/mo weekly gap reports won't retain past month two. The tutor-marketplace line is a hand-wave, not a plan.

notes.change: header brand title was invisible (dark --ink on shared dark kit header); forced light header title/sub text
post-analysis scroll put #results under the fixed header; added scroll-margin-top (plus light header title fix)

notes.note: Conversation analysis renders gap report; zero errors. Fixed header overlap.

notes.change: Added interactive drill mode: each gap card has 'Start interactive drill' — modal quizzes your own 5 moments with pattern checking (had/would/have-been), score, skip, and completion verdict. README next-3 #2 done.
